title: Anthropic Says World Needs System to Decide on AI Work Pause
title_zh: Anthropic 表示世界需要系统来决定人工智能工作暂停
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Anthropic PBC called for the creation of a system in which governments and artificial intelligence developers collectively decide when to slow work on the technology to stave off the risks it may pose.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Anthropic PBC 呼吁创建一个系统，让政府和人工智能开发人员共同决定何时放慢该技术的开发速度，以避免其可能带来的风险。

title: Taiwan's Foxconn raises guidance for second-quarter outlook
title_zh: 台湾富士康上调第二季度前景指引
summary: Taiwan's ‌Foxconn ‌said on Friday ​that its second-quarter performance is ‌likely to ⁠be well above ⁠its previously anticipated ​forecast ​of "significant" ​growth.
summary_zh: 台湾富士康周五表示，其第二季度业绩可能远高于之前“显着”增长的预期。

title: Why Meta is delaying its latest AI model release
title_zh: 为什么 Meta 推迟发布最新的人工智能模型
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to discuss Meta's (META) decision to delay the release of its latest AI model and what the move means for the company's AI ambitions.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起讨论《市场统治》，讨论 Meta (META) 推迟发布最新人工智能模型的决定，以及此举对公司的人工智能雄心意味着什么。

title: Nvidia's laptop chip is a bet that AI will need more than the cloud to flourish
title_zh: 英伟达的笔记本电脑芯片押注人工智能需要比云更多的东西才能蓬勃发展
summary: Nvidia on Monday unveiled its RTX Spark chip for Windows laptops at its GTC Taipei conference.
summary_zh: Nvidia 周一在 GTC 台北会议上推出了适用于 Windows 笔记本电脑的 RTX Spark 芯片。

title: Broadcom's sell-off just entered megacap history
title_zh: 博通的抛售刚刚进入巨型股历史

summary_zh: 博通 (Broadcom) 的市值正在蒸发近 3200 亿美元，在美国上市股票中排名第三。

title: Broadcom stock sinks. Are AI earnings expectations 'insatiable'?
title_zh: 博通股票下跌。人工智能的盈利预期是否“无法满足”？
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) stock sinks further in Thursday trading despite topping estimates for fiscal second quarter earnings and revenue, while also outpacing forecasts on third quarter guidance.
summary_zh: 博通 (AVGO) 股价在周四交易中进一步下跌，尽管第二财季盈利和收入超出预期，同时也超出了第三季度指引的预期。
